text: A Novel Proposal is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Zaruboggan and the primary destination is Primordia.

A Practice Partner is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Zarch Quokett and the primary destination is the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the Normal Mission Training Day.
A Precious Legacy is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Reclaimers and the primary destination is Primordia.

A President Not Present is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It leads to the Normal Mission Professorial. Veven can be found outside the Outfitters Test Hangar, behind the large crates by the entrance.
A Probing Issue is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Pathfinders to retrieve a Data Probe in Cauldros.
A Repairman's Resolve is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Female Mechanic and the primary destination is Primordia.
A Revised Regimen is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a male Wrothian and the primary destination is Cauldros.
A Scanner Scheme is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Drongo Caravan and the primary destination is Cauldros.
A Spicy New Spark is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Grenada Galactic Group and the primary destination is Cauldros.
A Spot of Gardening is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a female New Los Angeles resident and the primary destination is Cauldros.

A Thoughtful Man is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles between H.B. and Cross during the early morning.
A Troubled Man is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between H.B. and Cross.

A Diligent Man is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the ledge outside Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles between H.B. and Cross during the early morning.
A Kindly Man is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between H.B. and Cross during the early morning.
A Complicated Plan is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles between Mia and Cross at late night.
Adappin (Japanese: , Adappin) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at West Melville Street in the Commercial District during the morning.
Adsecula A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a yellow adsecula variant. It can be obtained from Etutanne, the Bloodthirsty in Primordia's Silent Mire.
Adsecula B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a black adsecula variant. It can be obtained from Bertrand, the Gorge Scourge in Oblivia's East Ibra Ravine.

A Missing BLADE is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.3, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Galdrs. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

A Tidy Partner is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.14, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting two Beaporges. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

A New Challenger is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.15, and is unlocked if both Skells are examined during Challenge Accepted!. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

A Rare Bird is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.16, and is unlocked if the Data Unit is examined during Love in the Orchard. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

A Sad End is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.17, and is unlocked if a Cervus's back is broken during Parasites. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Abominable Devil Wings are a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They have the same appearance on all characters.
Adder Byroad BC (Japanese: , Dokuja no Nukemichi BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the west end of Adder Byroad in Cauldros.

A-Spears are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Caladars. The Deva Caladar does not drop them, however.

The Adhesive Bandage is Casual Wear head armor in and . Only one can be obtained per playthrough.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. A Friend in Need (Japanese: , Shin'yū no Tameni) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Lecrough after talking to Galvin at the bottom of the southern staircase in the Great Hall in Alcamoth, opposite of Lecrough. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Achievements are a mechanic in . Achievements earned by meeting certain requirements. Upon earning an achievement, the player is awarded with a certain amount of Experience Points. There are a total of 200 achievements, divided into two categories: Trials are reset when the player begins a New Game +, allowing the player to earn them a second time. Records are not reset on New Game +. If the player did not earn the achievement on the first playthrough, their progress is carried over. For example if the "Please! No More!" achievement was not yet earned, enemies defeated on the first playthrough will be counted towards earning it in New Game +. Achievements are absent in . __TOC__

Active Cells are common materials in . They can only be dropped by Wool Seluas and Jelly Seluas in the Bionis' Interior. Active Cells are otherwise unavailable. According to their description, injecting them can rejuvenate someone in just thirty seconds and they are considered to be lively stuff.

Advanced Chambers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by two Mechon in Agniratha, or traded for with Peppino during Stopping the Elopement. According to their description, they are the latest custom-built parts, but they are not yet being mass produced. All "Advanced" materials share this description.

12 Brothersisterpon (Japanese: , Kafe Nopon Jūni Kyōdai) is a shop in . It is run by Motata and can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. It is specialized in Drinks. After finding all the Brothersisterpon scattered across Alrest, Sappan Veg Juice, Honey au Lait, and Crispy Blendshake become available for purchase. Store Deeds can be purchased after buying at least one of each item from the shop.
Acrobatic Bomber (Japanese: , Akurobattobomā, Lit. "Acrobat Bomber") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Bitball. In the , it is also one of Nia's arts when using Bunnie.
Abble's Fountain (Japanese: , Rakonto Funsui) is a Landmark in . It is a fountain in Tretl Windmill Plaza in Torigoth of Gormott Province.
The Admar Storage Zone (Japanese: , Adamā Kakunō-ku) is a Location in . It is located in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. There are no enemies in this area.

The Acid Gullet (Japanese: , San no Shokudō) is a location in . It is located in the Head of the Kingdom of Uraya, between the Windpipe Deeps and the Gullet Pass. The Note Fragment for Mysterious Note can be found here.

The 7th Perimeter Entrance (Japanese: , Dai-shichi Gaikaku Entoransu) is a Secret Area in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree between the Roadway to 7th Perimeter and the 7th Perimeter Center Floor. Despite being a Secret Area, this location must be passed through during normal gameplay.

The 7th Perimeter Center Floor (Japanese: , Dai-shichi Gaikaku Sentoraru Furoa) is a landmark in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree, between the 7th Perimeter Entrance and the Mizar Thoroughfare.

The 7th Perimeter Skyport (Japanese: , Dai-shichi Gaikaku Eapōto) is a landmark in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree. There is one Collection Point here, and a Salvage Point at the far end of the platform. The Blade Quest Artificial Intelligence is accepted here during Chapter 10. Visiting this landmark with Elma, Mythra, Shulk, and KOS-MOS in the party is necessary to unlock Elma's level 5 "Keen Eye" Field Skill.
The 7th Perimeter Defense Post (Japanese: , Dai-shichi Gaikaku Bōeitō) is a location in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree, above Mizar, Elevator #5. There is a Treasure Trove here.
The Adelno Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Adelno Music in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Addam's Love and War are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Aldomar Books in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Addam's Embercakes are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Lectica Vegetables in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Zeke.
Abyssturgeon Medallions are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tatraty Fish in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Roc.
Adelno Music is a shop in . It is run by Ollat and can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is specialized in Instruments.

Acute Melvyn (Japanese: , Ichiban Yari no Merukin) is a Unique Monster in . He is a Tirkin and can be found at level 25 at Twin Trunks Hill in the Gormott Province, just south of Boulderbore Gate. He must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 2 "Carnage" on her affinity chart. He can be fought as a level 99 Challenge Battle Enemy during Humanoid Alliance.

Acenia Fliers (Japanese: , Akenia Furaia) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. They are members of the Flier family and can be found at level 34-36 at Ysheva Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Perun's level 3 Punishment Strike on her affinity chart.

The Abandoned Excavation (Japanese: , Hōkisareta Saikutsujō-ato) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain, directly east of Eggle Jetty (Abandoned), and can be reached by traveling south on the walkways from Fourth Ridge Entrance above Chansagh Wastes. The Sealstone of Fire is located here, and must be accessed during A Real Challenge. There are no enemies here.

Addam's Appetite is a Heart-to-Heart in . It can be found next to Platini Deli at Elmos Square in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Staying at Anastatia's beforehand may trigger dialogue that directs the party to the Heart-to-Heart. The two options to choose for this are "Addam didn't actually like Addam's Embercakes" and "So the advertising slogan is just lying".

Acqua Pearl Pazzas are Meat Pouch items in . They can be cooked by Pyra at the kitchens in Tora's House and Corinne's House after receiving the recipe from Corinne. Two are needed for Crossette's level 3 Fortitude Field Skill.

Addam's Supercakes are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be cooked by Pyra at the kitchens in Tora's House and Corinne's House after A Tantalese Recipe is purchased from the Informant in Theosoir, Tantal. Two are needed for Crossette's level 4 Fortitude Field Skill.

Abyssturgeons are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, in particular the edges of the frozen lake around the Central Ether Boulder. In the , Abyssturgeons can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Abyss Metals are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Land of Morytha, in particular at the Collection Point east by southeast of the Fallen Skyscraper.

Abrachi Aries (Japanese: , Abaranchi Ariesu) are enemies in . They are members of the Aries family, and can be found at level 32 - 35 at the Three-Vein Crossroads on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

0-Battle Course+ (Japanese: , 0 kara Batoru Kōza: Zōkangō) are accessories in and . They increase the amount of experience earned by 50% when the wearer defeats enemies during combat. This effect applies to the entire party, but the boost will only take effect if the wearer lands the killing blow. They are the upgraded version of the 0-Battle Course accessory. The effect will stack together with EXP boosting Store Deeds and with all "Accelerated Growth" Common Blade Skills currently engaged on the wearer. This can be raised further with Level difference bonuses, but does not stack with Chain Attack Overkills.

Abyss Vests (Japanese: , Abisu Besuto) are accessories in . They increase the wearer's maximum HP stat by 24%. They can only be purchased from Shynini's Accessories for 5,000 Gold during the Story Quest Big Job Preparations. Only one can be obtained per playthrough. They are the upgraded version of the Gear Vest. The Jade Vest, Titanium Vest and Twin Trunks Vest accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Rigid Vest and Infantry Vest accessories.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Activity Amulets (Japanese: , Kassei no Amyuretto) are accessories in and . They increase the amount of HP recovered by the wearer from HP Potions by up to 24%. The Healing Amulet and Rebirth Amulet accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
Admiral Waltz (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Greataxe. When used, Mòrag swings her Greataxe diagonally two times against the enemy.

Acid Tomatoes are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found at Collection Points in Temperantia, particularly Agronomy points, some of which can be found near the Ardainian Garrison and the ridge of rocks between the two Titans in the Ruins of Judicium.

Addam's Tears are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, specifically at the Collection Point southeast of the Bone Road Skip Travel point. Four must be collected to unlock Elma's level 4 "Lockpicking" Field Skill.
Acar Nests (Japanese: , Akāru Nesuto) are enemies in . They are members of the Nest family, and can be found at level 50 - 52 at the Runo Cave-in in the Cliffs of Morytha.
A Small War is a quest in It can be received from Petir at Tretl Windmill Plaza in the Gormott Province during the third objective of the quest The Militia's Request.
Adella is an NPC in . Adella is an Ardainian who can be found at the Admar Storage Zone of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
A Real Challenge (Japanese: , Saikyō, The Most Ominous) is a Blade Quest in . It is provided by Zenobia in order to achieve one of her affinity bonuses in the Goldmouth Res. Dist..

Aatoban Garluses (Japanese: , Ahatobān Garuusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 50-56 at the Sacred Grove on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

Adenine's Password is a Quest in . It can be received after finding the glowing tablet and going back to the Goldmouth Warehouse during the quest Limits of Awareness. If the correct password for the tablet is given on the first try, this Quest will never be received, making it the only Quest that can be completely skipped.

|-|XC2= |-|NS2= A Phonex Tale (Japanese: , Fonekusu Bōkentan, Phonex Adventure Story) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Nim in the Fonsett Residential Area in the Leftherian Archipelago after Nim has reached level 3 Affinity Rewards. This quest is required to advance Nim's "Phonex Linguistics" Field Skill. Upon completion of this quest Nim's level 3 "Phonex Linguistics" Field Skill is unlocked.

The Absorp Quartz is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having her appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point at the Penitents' Spring in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.
A Young Man's Prize is a quest in . It is offered by Eluned at the southern end of Grodd Residential Zone in Torigoth, Gormott.
A Secret Cure is a quest in . It can be received from Iona at the Mymoma Playhouse in the Kingdom of Uraya.
A Gormotti Recipe is an Info Item in . It can be bought from the Informant at Torigoth in the Gormott Province for a base price of 1,000 G. Once obtained, Pyra can cook the Pan-Fried Tartari.

A Tantalese Recipe is an Info Item in . It can be bought from the Informant at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal during Chapter 10 for a base price of 1,000 G. Once obtained, Pyra can cook Addam's Supercakes.

The Adult Ardun (Japanese: , Seinen no Arudon) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Ardun family, and can be found at level 60 at the Kloom Farm in the Gormott Province, after supplying Pekka with a certain amount of food for his Ardun. This enemy will not respawn. It is recommended to not defeat the enemy, and to complete Ardun Rearing instead, to gain access to a Unique Monster Feeding the Ardun during the quest Ardun Rearing will change it to: * Infant Ardun (Lv 1) * Young Ardun (Lv 20) * Youthful Ardun (Lv 40) * Adult Ardun (Lv 60) * Ominous Ardun (Lv 80) * Relentless Arduran (Lv 99)

The Adventures Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Long-Awaited Work. It enables the purchase of the Adventures of Myram from the Reedirait Bookstore shop in Goldmouth at the Argentum Trade Guild.

Accessory Expander Kits are Key Items in . They are obtainable by trading 200,000 Bonus EXP with the Traveling Bard from Argentum Trade Guild upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). Accessory Expander Kits increase the number of Accessory slots available to a Driver by one, and each Driver can only use an Accessory Expander Kit once.

2,000 Wings (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Inferno Wheel.

This quest will become unavailable during and after Chapter 8. A Ripe New Frontier is a quest in . It can be received from Snififi in the Indoline Praetorium until a point during Chapter 8, although as long as it has been activated it can be completed at any time after this.

It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ in order to determine the effects of their Specials. When equipped to the Level 3 Special slot, it will also apply to the Level 4 Special. __TOC__

Aged Leraje (Japanese: , Sōrō no Reraje) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Volff family, and can be found at level 56 on the Radiocarpea Coast on the Fallen Arm at night. The Aged Leraje is significantly larger than the Caelum Volff it is accompanied by. It can drop the Royal Volff Hides needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Agile Barbatos (Japanese: , Shūrei no Barubatosu) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Ories family, and can be found at level 47 northeast of the Ignia Hill with a herd of Hista Aries at night. It can drop an Ories Horn, two of which are needed for Medical Advancements.
Air Fang (Japanese: , Ea Fangu) is one of Fiora's physical arts in . Fiora thrusts upward and then downward to generate two hits. Air Fang may inflict Break on the enemy.

All-Seeing Eyes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Quadwings in Makna Forest and traded for in Frontier Village. According to their description, they are still alive and they can even see properly at night. Three are needed to complete Secret Elixir Ingredients.

Agility is a stat in Xenoblade Chronicles, for all characters and enemies. This stat affects physical accuracy and evasion. From highest to lowest base agility, these are the playable characters: Dunban, Fiora, Riki, Shulk, Reyn, Sharla, and Melia.

Affluent Beleth (Japanese: , Hōkō no Bereto) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Upa family, and can be found at level 57 along the bottom water area of 5th Pulse Zone of the Fallen Arm. It can drop the Electric Upa Tears needed for The Wilted Flower.

Ageshu (Japanese: , Ākeshu) are an uncommon family of wading bird-like enemies in the . They move and behave very similarly to Flamii, but have a more demonic appearance. Their appearance changes little between the two games; in Ageshu have blue lines on their wings and in and they do not, but they are otherwise identical. In each game they appear, they can only be found in one locality and nowhere else.
Air Vangs (Japanese: , Eā Vanpu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 6 just south of the Mag Mell Ruins in Tephra Cave.

Affinity is a game mechanic in . Relationships among characters, as well as the party's reputation in various places, can be improved or worsened through various actions. Affinity among the playable characters and NPCs, as well as the global Area Affinity, can be viewed on the Affinity Chart from the main menu.

The Affection Seal Half is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Vidian makes it from a piece of Morning Dew Ice and asks the party to deliver it to Lesunia during Believing Again. It is later dropped by Telethia Lesunia during I Will Never Forget You or The Only Thing I Can Do, and must be returned to Vidian.

Aiming for the Top (Japanese: , Jōsō wo Mezase) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received automatically once the party reaches the 2nd Lift - GF while progressing through Mechonis Field.

The Agniratha Transporter (Japanese: , Teito Iki Ten'i Sōchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the fourth floor of the Central Factory. It is the final landmark encountered in the Central Factory, and is a transporter to Agniratha.
